risk_if_not_implemented: Without Authority To Collect, Process, Store & Share Personal Data (PD), Personal Data (PD) may be collected, processed, retained or shared without lawful authority or adequate safeguards, harming individuals and exposing the organization to regulatory action. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability (R-EX-5), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Privacy Harm / Unauthorized Processing (R-IP-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Data Mining Protection
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to protect data storage objects against unauthorized data mining and data harvesting techniques.
compensating_control_1.justification: Data Mining Protection (DCH-24.1) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Authority To Collect, Process, Store & Share Personal Data (PD) (PRI-12) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Access Enforcement
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce Logical Access Control (LAC) permissions that conform to the principle of "least privilege."
compensating_control_2.justification: Access Enforcement (IAC-25) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Authority To Collect, Process, Store & Share Personal Data (PD) (PRI-12) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
